attributes.name: Searing Arrows
attributes.powers:
Display this card; you may not do this during an encounter. After doing so, if you have more than 2 cards that have the Ammunition trait displayed, recharge 1 of them.

While displayed, when you play a weapon that has the Bow trait on your combat check, you may recharge a card to add 1d10 and the Fire trait.
